record.question: The procedure of withdrawal of pending Excise and Narcotics cases should be resorted to except in the following cases: (i) Cases in which, during the course of the proceedings in Court, it has been found that wrong persons have been sent up owing to obvious mistake during investigation. (ii) Cases which are so weak and are bound almost certain to end in acquittal and which in the first instance should not have been sent to Court. (iii) Cases where the offence is of a serious nature and public interest demands prosecution. (iv) Cases where withdrawal may adversely affect the deterrent effect of law enforcement.
